description: Stereo effects processor in four sections: a filter, a resonator, a ping-pong echo and an ambience reverb, with a modulation source and per-knob CV and randomisation mapping

params.text: Sets the cutoff of the filter, from 10Hz to 22000Hz
Tunes the resonator
Sets how far the modulation source moves the parameters that have been mapped to it
Sets the resonance of the filter
Sets how much of the resonator's output is fed back into it
Sets the rate of the modulation source
Sets the delay time of a two-tap stereo ping-pong echo, 10ms fully anti-clockwise out to 6 seconds fully clockwise; with a clock patched into SYNC the time is quantised to divisions of it
Sets the size, tone and direction of the ambience: smallest and brightest in the middle, biggest and darkest at either end, and running the input backwards below the middle
Sets how many times the echo repeats
Sets how long the ambience takes to die away
Sets the level of the filtered signal; when a cable is in the F.VCA jack this attenuates that CV instead
Sets how much resonator is mixed with the dry signal; when a cable is in the RESON jack this attenuates that CV instead
Sets how much echo is mixed with the dry signal; when a cable is in the ECHO jack this attenuates that CV instead
Sets how much ambience is mixed with the dry signal; when a cable is in the AMBIENCE jack this attenuates that CV instead
Picks what MAP applies to the knobs: randomisation, CV mapping, or modulation
Held down, it turns the knobs and buttons over to their second function
Fires a randomisation of everything the random mapping covers, which a trigger at the RANDOM input also does
Applies the mapping for whichever target the map mode names, so that turning a knob then sets that amount rather than the value
Picks the modulation shape: random, sine, ramp, inverted ramp, square, sample and hold, or envelope follower
Picks the filter type: lowpass, bandpass, highpass or comb
Moves the filter to one of four points in the chain, before or after the resonator, the echo and the ambience
Spreads the resonator's partials away from a harmonic series
A single sweep that cuts the lows one way and the highs the other on the echo, leaving the signal untouched in the middle
Pans the ambience from side to side on its own
Sets how far the modulation source moves this parameter, from nothing to its full range
Sets how far the CV input moves this parameter, from nothing to its full range
Sets how far a randomisation event moves this parameter, from nothing to its full range
Wipes the mapping amounts for whichever target the map mode names

inputs.text: The left side of the signal going in, and with nothing patched on the right it feeds both sides in mono
The right side of the signal going in
Sets the dry and wet balance of that section, 0V to 5V, attenuated by that section's own mix knob
A clock for the time-based sections; with it patched the echo time snaps to divisions of the clock
A rising edge here fires a randomisation of everything the random mapping covers
Shifts the filter cutoff, -5V to 10V, scaled by the cutoff CV amount set through MAP
Shifts the resonator tuning, -5V to 10V, scaled by the tune CV amount set through MAP
Shifts the echo time, -5V to 10V, scaled by the echo CV amount set through MAP
Shifts the ambience spacetime, -5V to 10V, scaled by the spacetime CV amount set through MAP

outputs.text: The left side of the finished signal
The right side of the finished signal

notes: the resonator, echo and ambience mix knobs all come up fully dry, so the input passes through the filter alone until one of them is turned up.
the Randomise slew time slider on the menu is greyed out while Use native VCV randomisation is switched on.
menu: Knob mode — fixes which layer the knobs edit without a button held down: Normal, Alt (hold Shift), Mod, CV or Rnd
Use native VCV randomisation — hands randomising over to Rack's own; off by default
Randomise slew time — a slider setting how long a randomisation takes to slew into place, from 0 to 10 seconds, and 0.2 seconds by default

inputs.6: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.7: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
